publishedMetadata.title: Retries and cancellation
publishedMetadata.description: TanStack Query 5 applied lesson for retries and cancellation, featuring a deliberately broken starter, instructor fix, real HTTP/React cache behavior, and security-aware failure handling.
objectives: Pass AbortSignal into fetch, distinguish HTTP 4xx and 5xx, and bound automatic retry behavior.
Abort an in-flight request on unmount; ensure no stale result is committed. Mock 422 (zero retries), 503 (bounded retries), and a network failure.
Do not retry credential failures or validation errors; aggressive retries can amplify a production incident and expose service capacity limits.
